comments.body:
#153 batch 13 hit this again: a REST CLI calling http_* with auth headers gets one 'Querying url:' stderr line per request, and an agent calling it sees them all. No per-call opt-out (http_* never set RequestDef.Quiet, core/requester.go:244-246); url: blocks have quiet but can't send headers. The global -q also hides print/pprint, and it only works after the script path: `rad -q x.rad` and a `#!/usr/bin/env -S rad --quiet` shebang both fail with 'Unknown arguments: [x.rad]', so a script can't quiet itself. Suggests quiet=true on http_*, or silent by default with the line under --debug.

#153 batch 13 (item 13) and batch 15 hit this. Batch 15: a script calling a REST API that takes its key and token as query parameters logged both to stderr on every call; they went into an agent transcript and terminal scrollback and the token had to be rotated. Still on main. Now tracked on the sprint board with a redaction ask added.
